confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Metro Manila price levels (Makati, Malate, Ermita, BGC), not checked against live listings or booking pages. Restaurant and drink anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely by district and star rating. Taxes and mandatory fees are assumed included for accommodation. The FX value comes from a third-party site that republishes RBA figures and was not verified on rba.gov.au in this session. Confirm it against the RBA F11 table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Southeast Asian capital-city basis, benchmarked against Bangkok and Ho Chi Minh City, adjusted for Metro Manila's relatively higher hotel prices and lower dining costs. No single comparable city was used.
